MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. This neuron is essentially an inhibitory unit whose informative signal is its strong negative response to word-stem sub-tokens that are about to be completed by the suffix "-ant" ("convers|ant", "entr|ants", "fond|ant"); its near-zero "max" activations are diffuse and unspecific, spread over ordinary function/content words (her, was, be, become, commas) with no clear pattern.
